title: Verify European compact OBJ sixth runtime
changes: Record managed publication and native reader acceptance for the sixth sparse compact OBJ bank.
validation: Retained Windows test executable and recorded ROM, manifest and TinyCC hashes matched; isolated Wine test passed 95 prior-resource comparisons, sparse bytes and gap boundaries, transactional tamper rejection and native/interpreter full-state and clock equality.
limitations: The historical temporary build snapshot was retired and could not be rechecked. Production CLI, ordinary use, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified; no performance measurements.
